scientific_integrity: Direct mathematical proof and locally executed finite checks; no independent audit, external certification, or previously published authorship is claimed.
scientific_limitations: All-rank structural result for free anticommutative antiassociative algebras of rank r>=3 over fields of characteristic !=2. Finite-field count is for odd prime powers; result is not asserted for arbitrary quotients or arbitrary binary Zinbiel algebras. Remm 2025 previously established the underlying free exterior-graded algebra, and Ismailov et al. 2023 previously published its seven-dimensional non-Zinbiel example. Literature comparison is bounded, and equivalent broader prior coverage remains possible.
title: Maximal square-zero subalgebras in free anticommutative antiassociative algebras
